verdict.rationale: Cooley Go offers document generators (NDA, incorporation package with IP Assignment tied to stock purchase agreements) and Cooley's Labor and Employment practice serves 3,000+ clients, but there is no direct evidence of dedicated offer-letter, employment-agreement, or standalone employee invention-assignment/confidentiality templates as part of a documented hiring practice. Missing for 10: explicit offer letter templates, employment agreement generator, and employee-specific invention-assignment/confidentiality document (the existing IP assignment is bundled with founder stock purchase, not general hiring).
